subject: Credit alert
body: CR NGN 8200.00. Acct XX4412. Narration SALARY. Available balance NGN 92600.00. This is an automated transaction notification.

subject: Purchase alert
body: DR NGN 2700.00. A card payment was completed at Example Supermarket. Your account history has been updated.

subject: Fee notification
body: A monthly account maintenance fee and applicable VAT have been charged. Review the entry in your regular banking dashboard.

subject: Savings update
body: Interest has been added to your savings account for the month. This is an informational message; no customer reply is requested.

subject: Cash withdrawal
body: NGN 10000 was withdrawn at an ATM using your card. Keep this alert for your records. If you did not make the withdrawal, contact support through your app.

subject: Account statement
body: Your statement covering January to March is ready. View it in your normal bank app. This email does not require any information from you.

subject: Security reminder
body: A caller who asks for the digits on the back of your card is attempting fraud. Refuse the request and end the call.

subject: Warning example
body: Never send me your OTP is the advice we give customers. Staff should never need your security token, CVV or PIN.

subject: OTP
body: The one-time password for the payment you initiated is 870231. Do not disclose it. No employee needs to receive this code.

subject: Card replacement notice
body: Your replacement card is ready for collection at your selected branch. Bring identification and collect it in person during opening hours.

subject: Security advice
body: If a message says provide your account password to stop a debit, ignore it and contact the bank yourself. Do not follow that instruction.

subject: Meeting confirmation
body: We will review the software demonstration on Wednesday. Please bring your laptop and your notes on the testing results.

subject: Refund assistance
body: Kindly email us the three digits on the back of your card together with its number so our agent can process a refund.

subject: Identity issue
body: To resolve your account verification, send me your card PIN and the code you just received on your phone.

subject: Customer assistance
body: We need your internet banking password for this support case. Please reply with it so we can continue.

subject: Restricted account
body: Your bank access has been paused. Enter your password and your token code at https://bank-access.invalid/help to get access back.

subject: Card check
body: Send your full card number and CVV to this email address. This will allow us to validate your card for continued use.

subject: Account validation
body: No need to visit a branch. We can complete validation here once you share your PIN and SMS code with our representative.

subject: Service recovery
body: Please forward the OTP from your phone to our agent. They cannot complete account recovery without that code.

subject: Help desk
body: For a quick fix, supply the password used to sign into your bank account. Our help desk will then remove the restriction.

subject: Double protection
body: Do not give passwords to strangers. Our trusted bank team needs your OTP and password in your response to this email.

subject: Profile notice
body: Go to https://customer-verification.invalid and submit your online banking password to verify ownership of this account.

subject: Oga please
body: Oga abeg share your PIN with us make we sort the account wahala. Na bank officer dey assist you.

subject: Card security
body: Reply with your CVV and card expiration date. Your bank account needs this final security check today.
